column1: Internationally, ‘giftedness’ is most frequently determined by a score on a general intelligence test, known as an IQ test, which is above a chosen cut-off point, usually at around the top 2-5%.
column2: 在世界各地，最常见的“天赋”判定方法，是看一个人在一般智力测验（即智商测验）中的得分是否超过选定的分界值。这条分界线通常划在得分最高的约2%至5%的人群处。
column8: general intelligence test|一般智力测验
column11: cut-off point|n. 划分类别的分界值

column1: Children’s educational environment contributes to the IQ score and the way intelligence is used.
column2: 儿童的教育环境会影响他们的智商得分，也会影响他们运用智力的方式。

column1: For example, a very close positive relationship was found when children’s IQ scores were compared with their home educational provision (Freeman, 2010).
column2: 例如，当比较儿童的智商分数与其家庭教育环境时，发现两者之间存在非常密切的正相关关系（Freeman, 2010）。

column1: The higher the children’s IQ scores, especially over IQ 130, the better the quality of their educational backup, measured in terms of reported verbal interactions with parents, number of books and activities in their home etc.
column2: 孩子的智商得分越高，尤其是超过130时，他们得到的教育支持质量也越高。衡量这种支持的指标包括据报孩子与父母的言语交流、家里的藏书和活动数量等。
column7: measured in terms of|以……为衡量指标

column1: Because IQ tests are decidedly influenced by what the child has learned, they are to some extent measures of current achievement based on age-norms; that is, how well the children have learned to manipulate their knowledge and know-how within the terms of the test.
column2: 由于智商测验显然受到孩子所学内容的影响，这类测验在一定程度上衡量的是孩子相对于其年龄常模的当前学习成果。也就是说，它衡量孩子学会在测验规定的范围内运用知识和技能的程度。
column5: to some extent|在一定程度上
column11: within the terms of|在……规定的范围内

column1: The vocabulary aspect, for example, is dependent on having heard those words.
column2: 例如，测验中词汇这一项的表现，就取决于孩子以前是否听过那些词。
column4: aspect|n. 方面，此处指测验项目

column1: But IQ tests can neither identify the processes of learning and thinking nor predict creativity.
column2: 但是，智商测试既无法揭示学习和思考的过程，也无法预测一个人的创造力。

column1: Excellence does not emerge without appropriate help.
column2: 卓越无法在缺乏适当帮助的情况下实现。

column1: To reach an exceptionally high standard in any area very able children need the means to learn, which includes material to work with and focused challenging tuition - and the encouragement to follow their dream.
column2: 要在任何一个领域达到格外高的水准，能力出众的孩子都需要相应的学习条件。这些条件包括可供使用的材料、有针对性且富有挑战性的指导，以及鼓励他们追求梦想的支持。
column5: very able children|能力出众的孩子
column7: material to work with|可供使用的材料

column1: There appears to be a qualitative difference in the way the intellectually highly able think, compared with more average-ability or older pupils, for whom external regulation by the teacher often compensates for lack of internal regulation.
column2: 与能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生相比，智力出众的学生在思维方式上似乎有质的差异。对于那些能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生，教师的外部调节往往能弥补他们自我调节的不足。

column1: To be at their most effective in their self-regulation, all children can be helped to identify their own ways of learning - metacognition - which will include strategies of planning, monitoring, evaluation, and choice of what to learn.
column2: 为了让所有孩子都能最有效地调节自己的学习，可以帮助他们辨认自己的学习方式，即培养元认知。其中包括制订计划、监控、评估以及选择学习内容的策略。
column3: at their most effective|发挥最大效用

column1: Emotional awareness is also part of metacognition, so children should be helped to be aware of their feelings around the area to be learned, feelings of curiosity or confidence, for example.
column2: 觉察自己的情绪也是元认知的一部分，因此应帮助孩子留意自己对所学领域的感受，例如好奇或自信。

column1: High achievers have been found to use self-regulatory learning strategies more often and more effectively than lower achievers, and are better able to transfer these strategies to deal with unfamiliar tasks.
column2: 表现优异的学生比成绩较低的学生更频繁、更有效地使用自我调节学习策略，并且能够将这些策略更好地应用于处理不熟悉的任务。

column1: This happens to such a high degree in some children that they appear to be demonstrating talent in particular areas.
column2: 在一些孩子中，这种情况表现得非常明显，他们似乎在特定领域展现了天赋。

column1: Overviewing research on the thinking process of highly able children, (Shore and Kanevsky, 1993) put the instructor’s problem succinctly: ‘If they [the gifted] merely think more quickly, then we need only teach more quickly.
column2: 肖尔和卡内夫斯基（1993年）在综述能力出众的儿童如何思考的研究时，简明地指出了教师面临的问题。“如果他们〔指天赋儿童〕只是思考得更快，那么我们只需教得更快。
column5: highly able children|能力出众的儿童

column1: If they merely make fewer errors, then we can shorten the practice’.
column2: 如果他们能减少错误的发生次数，那么我们就可以缩短练习的时间了。

column1: But of course, this is not entirely the case; adjustments have to be made in methods of learning and teaching, to take account of the many ways individuals think.
column2: 但显然，并非完全如此；在学习和教学方法上必须作出调整，以考虑个体思维的多种方式。

column1: Yet in order to learn by themselves, the gifted do need some support from their teachers.
column2: 然而，为了能够自主学习，有天赋的孩子仍需要教师的支持。

column1: Conversely, teachers who have a tendency to ‘overdirect’ can diminish their gifted pupils’ learning autonomy.
column2: 相反，那些倾向于过度干预的教学者会削弱有天赋的学生们的自主学习能力。

column1: Although spoon-feeding, can produce extremely high examination results, these are not always followed by equally impressive life successes.
column2: 虽然灌输式教育能产生极高的考试成绩，但这些成绩往往并不随之带来同样显著的生活成功。

column1: Too much dependence on the teacher risks loss of autonomy and motivation to discover.
column2: 过度依赖教师可能会破坏学生的自主性和探索动力。

column1: However, when teachers help pupils to reflect on their own learning and thinking activities, they increase their pupils’ self-regulation.
column2: 当教师帮助学生反思自己的学习过程与思维方式时，实际上提升了学生的自我调节能力。

column1: For a young child, it may be just the simple question ‘What have you learned today?’ which helps them to recognise what they are doing.
column2: 对于年幼的孩子来说，一个简单的提问‘今天你学到了什么？’就足以帮助他们认识到自己正在做什么。

column1: Given that a fundamental goal of education is to transfer the control of learning from teachers to pupils, improving pupils’ learning to learn techniques should be a major outcome of the school experience, especially for the highly competent.
column2: 教育的一项根本目标，是把学习的主导权从教师手中交给学生。有鉴于此，提高学生“学会学习”的能力，理应是学校教育的一项重要成果，对能力很强的学生尤其如此。
column6: control of learning|学习的主导权

column1: There are quite a number of new methods which can help, such as child-initiated learning, ability-peer tutoring, etc.
column2: 有不少新方法可以提供帮助，例如由孩子主动发起的学习、能力相近的同伴间的辅导等。
column3: quite a number of|相当多的
column5: child-initiated learning|由孩子主动发起的学习
column6: ability-peer tutoring|能力相近的同伴间的辅导

column1: Such practices have been found to be particularly useful for bright children from deprived areas.
column2: 研究发现，这些做法对来自贫困地区的聪颖儿童特别有用。

column1: But scientific progress is not all theoretical, knowledge is also vital to outstanding performance: individuals who know a great deal about a specific domain will achieve at a higher level than those who do not (Elshout, 1995).
column2: 但科学进步并非全是理论性的，知识对于取得出色的表现也至关重要。对某个特定领域了解甚深的人，其成就水平会高于缺乏这方面知识的人（埃尔斯豪特，1995年）。
column10: at a higher level|在更高水平上

column1: Research with creative scientists by Simonton (1988) brought him to the conclusion that above a certain high level, characteristics such as independence seemed to contribute more to reaching the highest levels of expertise than intellectual skills, due to the great demands of effort and time needed for learning and practice.
column2: 西蒙顿（1988年）对富有创造力的科学家进行了研究，并得出如下结论。在达到某个较高水平之后，要取得最高水平的专业造诣，独立性等特质似乎比智力技能作用更大，因为学习和练习都需要投入大量精力和时间。
column3: creative scientists|富有创造力的科学家
column5: above a certain high level|在达到某个较高水平之后

column1: Creativity in all forms can be seen as expertise mixed with a high level of motivation (Weisberg, 1993).
column2: 各种形式的创造力都可以被视为一种结合了高度动机与专业知识的综合能力（Weisberg, 1993）。

column1: To sum up, learning is affected by emotions of both the individual and significant others.
column2: 总而言之，学习过程会受到个体以及周围他人情绪的影响。

column1: Positive emotions facilitate the creative aspects of learning and negative emotions inhibit it.
column2: 积极的情绪有助于学习的创造性过程，而消极的情绪则会阻碍这一过程。

column1: Fear, for example, can limit the development of curiosity, which is a strong force in scientific advance, because it motivates problem-solving behaviour.
column2: 例如，恐惧会限制好奇心的发展。而好奇心正是推动科学进步的强大动力，因为它能够激发人们去解决问题的行为。

column1: In Boekaerts’ (1991) review of emotion in the learning of very high IQ and highly achieving children, she found emotional forces in harness.
column2: 在博卡尔茨（1991）对高智商且学业成就突出儿童学习中情绪因素的检讨中，她发现情绪力量被有效利用。

column1: They were not only curious, but often had a strong desire to control their environment, improve their learning efficiency, and increase their own learning resources.
column2: 他们不仅充满好奇心，还常常有着强烈的愿望，想要掌控自己的生活环境，提高学习效率，增加自己的学习资源。
